svg.text: a counter per reason, kept with the reader's cursor
a line that is not JSON, fails the envelope or the allow-list, has an unknown type,
is too long, lies past 64 MiB, names another run or sits in a symbolic link is dropped;
the next line is read. Nothing in an event is executed; its paths are only names under the run root.
spike T2 captures, one cell each
9 converted to spool files by convert_t2.py:
the 6 Tower captures are not spool events
